cohort: Hospitalized adult patients admitted to Universiti Kebangsaan Medical Centre (UKMMC) in Malaysia with diagnoses of ST-elevated myocardial infarction (STEMI), elective lower segment caesarean section (LSCS), or elective total knee replacement (TKR) between June 2008 and December 2010.
finding: The implementation of clinical pathways significantly reduced the length of stay for patients undergoing elective LSCS and those with STEMI, without increasing complication or readmission rates across all studied conditions.
cross-section timing: Data collected from June 2008 to December 2010, comparing patients admitted before February 2009 (control) and after February 2009 (CP group).
